<mxfile host="draw.io"> <diagram name="Infrastructure Overview" id="infra-overview"> <mxGraphModel dx="1200" dy="800" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1600" pageHeight="900" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0"/> <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
<!-- External: Ansible Controller (localhost) --> <mxCell id="ctrl" value="Ansible Controller
(localhost)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="340" width="160" height="60" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Proxmox Host 1 Container --> <mxCell id="pve1" value="Proxmox Host 1 (pve)
.185" style="swimlane;startSize=30;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;rounded=1;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="280" y="40" width="500" height="280" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="c1" value="k8s-control-1
.186" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="pve1"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="50" width="130" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n1" value="k8s-node-1
.187" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="pve1"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="120" width="130" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kubevip1" value="kube-vip

(LVM thin pool)" style="shape=cylinder3;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;boundedLbl=1;backgroundOutline=1;size=10;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="pve1"> <mxGeometry x="360" y="130" width="110" height="60" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>

.189" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;" vertex="1" parent="pve2"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="120" width="130" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="kubevip2" value="kube-vip
VIP: .210" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="pve2"> <mxGeometry x="200" y="50" width="120" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="iso2" value="Ubuntu ISO
(autoinstall)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="pve2"> <mxGeometry x="360" y="50" width="110" height="50" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="storage2" value="Secondary Storage

<!-- Kubeconfig store --> <mxCell id="kubeconfig" value="~/.kube/config" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="440" width="160" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- .env --> <mxCell id="dotenv" value=".env
(all configuration)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#666666;fontColor=#666666;fontSize=10;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="240" width="160" height="40" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<!-- Edges --> <mxCell id="e_ctrl_pve1" edge="1" source="ctrl" target="pve1" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.25;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_ctrl_pve1_label" value="Proxmoxer API" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_ctrl_pve1"> <mxGeometry x="-0.2" relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_ctrl_pve2" edge="1" source="ctrl" target="pve2" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;exitX=1;exitY=0.75;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_ctrl_pve2_label" value="Proxmoxer API" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];fontSize=9;" vertex="1" connectable="0" parent="e_ctrl_pve2"> <mxGeometry x="-0.2" relative="1" as="geometry"><mxPoint as="offset"/></mxGeometry> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_dotenv_ctrl" edge="1" source="dotenv" target="ctrl" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_c1_vip" edge="1" source="c1" target="kubevip1" parent="pve1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e_c2_vip" edge="1" source="c2" target="kubevip2" parent="pve2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
<mxCell id="e_ctrl_kube" edge="1" source="ctrl" target="kubeconfig" parent="1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;orthogonalLoop=1;jettySize=auto;html=1;dashed=1;"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/> </mxCell>
</root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
